title: FedTGNN-SS: leakage-controlled evaluation of federated semi-supervised graph neural networks for gestational and other diabetes prediction (code, protocol and results)
description: Code, prespecified analysis protocol, leakage unit tests and run-level results accompanying the article 'Federated Semi-Supervised Graph Neural Networks for the Prediction of Gestational and Other Diabetes from Tabular Records: A Leakage-Controlled Evaluation'. No patient data are included; the datasets are available from Kaggle and the UCI Machine Learning Repository.
